tells.label: Gibberish on the highway sign
tells.detail: The sign reads like "EB JE P ETHI" and "EIITER KKIMTIV". Real highway signs use real words; AI video still struggles to render text.

tells.label: Metal sign folds like fabric
tells.detail: The steel sign wraps around the car and hangs in soft green ribbons, as if it were cloth.

note.text: The video is AI-generated, not a real crash. The highway sign shows garbled, nonsensical text—a common AI artifact. Fact-checks and analyses confirm it's fabricated.    https://www.ptinews.com/fact-detail/ai-generated-video-of-mahindra-thar-crashing-into-overhead-signboard-falsely-shared-as-real-details-inside/3393909  https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/auto/cars/mahindra-thar-crashing-into-highway-signboard-real-or-fake-heres-the-truth/articleshow/128591816.cms  https://www.reddit.com/r/isthisAI/comments/1rgqjaj/saw_this_on_instagram_and_genuinely_cant_tell_if
